basis: Fixed scope/cap candidates; v9 auction model unchanged. Select on 610 development auctions only. Same-season keepers are known before the auction; only preseason forecasts and preceding actual pools are used. Later seasons are reused checks, not independent validation.
claim_calibration: No older unsuccessful-claim logs exist. Claim reliability is an explicit working assumption, not calibrated from these historical errors.
